unit: passage with source document, neighbouring units, metadata and related graph evidence

strata.name: legislation
strata.predicate: source_type == law; excluding historical and ambiguous

strata.name: codes_decrees
strata.predicate: source_type in code,decree,constitution; excluding historical and ambiguous

strata.name: benchmark_risk
strata.predicate: R0 dev failure gold and returned passages; categories round-robin

selection: Sort document and passage IDs, shuffle with independent Random(0) for each stratum, round-robin documents before repeating one. For benchmark_risk round-robin failure categories then IDs. Record exact sample, pool sizes and overlaps. If a pool is too small, report shortfall; no easy replacements.
graph_sampling: Up to 20 edges per actual relation, sorted by source,target,relation,evidence_passage_id then Random(0). Separate edge denominator.
benchmark_access: Existing R0 dev outputs/gold for offline audit only; no rerun, no validation/holdout tuning.
checks: identity against official raw heading and URL
clean vs independently decoded raw HTML/PDF
denominators: Report eligible, evaluated, numerator, unknown, exclusions per metric. Rates over evaluated units, with unknown coverage shown. No composite score. Risk-enriched sample is not a population estimate.
uncertainty: Descriptive stratified audit; no misleading corpus-wide confidence interval. Distinguish exact automated checks from semantic/legal verification.
temporal_policy: UNKNOWN without evidence is valid. Never infer current law; unsupported temporal assertions are defects.
canonical_policy: Segments of one article can share a fragment ID. Different content hashes alone are not collisions; require distinct legal locators/structural units sharing an identity.
source_policy: Official/public sources only. Retained raw snapshots evidence ingestion, not current law. Missing evidence remains UNKNOWN/UNVERIFIED.
constraints: feature branch push only; no merge
